finding_text: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.
The written procedures for recalls were inadequate.
The assessment, documentation, and/or procedures for considering the resale of returned drugs were inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 반품 의약품의 재판매 여부 검토에 관한 평가, 문서화 및/또는 절차가 부적절했다.

finding_text: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.
finding_text_ko: 변경관리(change control) 시스템이 변경사항을 적절히 문서화, 평가 및/또는 승인하도록 보장하기에 부적절했다.

finding_text: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.
The operators'aseptic practices were inadequate to maintain sterility.
finding_text_ko: 작업자의 무균 작업 관행(aseptic practices)이 무균성을 유지하기에 부적절했다.

finding_text: The creation, maintenance, processing, and/or review of laboratory data was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 시험실 데이터의 생성, 유지, 처리 및/또는 검토가 부적절했다.

finding_text: When the particulate and microbiological limits were exceeded, the company's operating procedures did not prescribe an investigation and implementation of corrective actions.
finding_text_ko: 미립자 및 미생물 한도를 초과했을 때, 회사의 작업 절차는 조사(investigation) 및 시정조치(corrective actions) 이행을 규정하지 않았다.

finding_text: Evaluation of production processes, equipment, and/or materials was inadequate. The operators'aseptic practices were inadequate to maintain sterility.
finding_text_ko: 제조 공정, 설비 및/또는 원자재에 대한 평가가 부적절했다. 작업자의 무균 작업 관행(aseptic practices)이 무균성을 유지하기에 부적절했다.

finding_text: The samples taken for sterility testing were not representative of the whole batch.
finding_text_ko: 무균시험(sterility testing)용으로 채취한 검체가 배치 전체를 대표하지 않았다.

finding_text: The training of personnel before new or revised standard operating procedures were implemented was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 신규 또는 개정 표준작업절차서(SOP) 시행 전 직원 교육이 부적절했다.
